images.site: The land is blanketed in deep white snow and snowdrifts, with towering dark neutral grey rock cliffs heavily covered with thick white snow and ice and distant snow-covered mountains, on a frozen lifeless alien planet of bare rock, ice and wind-blown snow.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are plain snow-covered dark rock sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.

images.site: The land is made of baked deep muted oxblood-red earth, with towering scorched dark basalt cliffs with a few thin glowing orange lava cracks and distant mountains, on a sun-baked lifeless alien planet of bare scorched rock, with thick columns of volcanic smoke rising in the distance.
images.ground: The lower two thirds of the frame are plain dark scorched rock sinking into deep shadow, darker and darker toward the bottom edge, with no object.
